api.name: Memory Retrieve — Sparse Gate + Context URL Params

metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.description: Response-shape contract for the Phase 14.x retrieval URL params, default-on in production but previously referenced by ZERO specs: ?sparse=, ?sparse_percentile=, ?context=auto, ?strict_context=, ?intent= (INTENT-DISABLE-001). CONTRACT: URL params override only fields the body left unset; the response always carries results[] + debug{}; ALL sparse_gate_*/below_threshold_* debug fields are conditional (present only when the gate fires) so clients MUST treat them as optional — these specs pin types-when-present, never presence. Invalid percentiles are ignored (still 200, default applies), never an error. ?intent=true|false toggles intent translation per-call (recommended OFF per the 120q A/B); either value is a normal 200 with unchanged response shape.

variants.name: sparse_disabled_via_url
variants.description: ?sparse=false suppresses the gate for this call (operator per-call opt-out, Phase 14.1.1); still a normal 200 retrieval.

variants.name: context_auto_derivation
variants.description: ?context=auto triggers server-side query→fingerprint derivation (Phase 14.2.1) when the body carries no explicit fingerprint; the response contract is unchanged (derivation is internal).

variants.name: strict_context_mode
variants.description: ?strict_context=true drops candidates below the Jaccard threshold pre-scoring (Phase 14.2.3); fewer/zero results is valid — only the shape is contracted.

variants.name: invalid_percentile_ignored
variants.description: Out-of-range ?sparse_percentile (valid: 0.5–0.999) is ignored — the call still succeeds with the configured default; URL-param validation never turns a retrieve into an error.

variants.name: intent_translation_via_url
variants.description: ?intent=true forces the per-call intent-translation rewrite (INTENT-DISABLE-001 override; only sets it when the body left translate_intent unset). The rewrite is internal/fail-open — the response shape is unchanged (results[] + debug{}), always a 200.
